topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: I can't believe my neighbor has the nerve to ask for a chunk of my yard to start a garden. Like I don’t have enough to deal with keeping up my property, now I’m supposed to share it? This is my space, not some communal plot. What’s next, turning the whole neighborhood into a farm? I’ve been clear about my boundaries before, but I guess some people just don’t get the hint. I’m not going to say yes, and I’m definitely not going to make it easy for them. If they want to garden, they can find their own land.
